messages:
Maya: Quick design check — compact run history + function defs. Two layout options, need input before Thu sync. TL;DR: Option A = two-column (invocation list | details panel). Option B = accordion stacked rows with inline schema preview. Which direction for default?
Samir: Figma mock posted: https://figma.com/s/compact-run-proto (please ignore placeholder copy). Main question: keyboard/focus behavior for expand. :eyes:
Eli: Keyboard thoughts: one-row focus, expand with Enter/Space to reveal details. Each row header should be role=button and have aria-expanded. Also copy nit: prefer "Invocation details" over "Run details" — clearer for users.
Nora: For function defs: show params as "name: type" inline and collapse long JSON schema behind "Show more". Hide advanced/experimental flags behind a chevron to reduce noise.
Chris: Two-column is nice on wide screens but will be cramped on smaller windows. Suggest responsive breakpoint (<=980px) that switches to accordion automatically. Also concerned about scroll context when details panel opens — should not steal scroll from list.
Maya: Accessibility nits: ensure expand/collapse uses aria-controls + aria-expanded, visible focus ring (high contrast), and avoid focus traps in the details panel (escape should close panel and return focus to originating row).
Eli: Small copy nit: primary action on history items should read "Invoke" not "Run" to match API/console wording. Secondary CTA could be "Re-run" for repeat invocations. :+1:
deploy-bot: feature-flag update: feature-flag:playground_history_layout -> rolled out to 20% in prod at 2024-09-18T14:22:00Z.
Samir: Quick poll — reply with A or B please. I'll collect votes and summarize before Thurs. Also adding an engineering TODO: wire keyboard shortcuts and focus states.
Nora: A — like inline schemas and quick parameter peek.
Chris: B — prefer stacked rows, easier to scan on laptop screens with many items.
Maya: Thanks — consensus leaning mixed. Eli, can you update the prototype with the "Invoke" copy + keyboard flows and add the responsive breakpoint? I'll bring this to product sync Thu. Thanks all!
